say:1:1736402001:1.text: Greetings, Magister Merlin. I'm searching for a young lady I've met only once.
say:1:1736402001:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下。抱歉，让您见笑了。我正在寻找一名只见过一面的少女。
say:1:1736402001:1.male: Greetings, Magister Merlin. I'm searching for a young lady I've met only once.

say:2:1736402002:1.text: Last night, I had the honor of judging a swordsmanship competition. A contestant named Cinderella absolutely blew me away with her swordplay!
say:2:1736402002:1.source_cn: 昨晚，我受邀担任了一场剑术比赛的评委。那场比赛中有个叫...

say:3:1736402003:1.text: Her fighting style was purely practical. Every strike was straight to the point, without a single unnecessary movement!
say:3:1736402003:1.source_cn: 干净利落，没有任何多余的动作，完全是实战派的打法！
say:3:1736402003:1.male: Her fighting style was purely practical. Every strike was straight to the point, without a single unnecessary movement!
say:3:1736402003:1.female: Her fighting style was purely practical. Every strike was straight to the point, without a single unnecessary movement!
